title: HEP Conference Hub: An Auditable Portal for Discovering and Monitoring High-Energy Physics Events
description:
HEP Conference Hub is an auditable web portal for discovering and monitoring conferences, symposia, workshops and schools in high-energy physics. The platform separates event, abstract-submission and registration status; preserves official source URLs, evidence excerpts, confidence and verification timestamps; and includes regional discovery focused on Latin America.

The software combines FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Next.js, Scrapy, Celery, Redis and Docker Compose.
